messages:
marta: Ran a perf sweep this morning comparing kernel-autopick behavior across L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100. Saw a consistent ~15-20% tail-latency bump on L4 when the KV cache triggers eviction around seqlen=1024. Noticed kernel selector falls back to the generic matmul path pretty often. :thinking:

kevin: can you paste the run command + the small repro input? which model and batch mix?

marta: repro command: `./run_profile --model=gpt-official-13b --seq=1024 --batch-mix=50:2,10:6 --kv-size=1.2gb --autopick=on --profile=flame`. Model variant: quantized-4bit, single-stream mostly.

marta: profiling snippet (top kers/time):
```
kernel chosen: generic_matmul_v2  -> 23.4 ms/token
kernel chosen: fp16_batched_matmul -> 9.8 ms/token
kv-evict handler         -> 1.2 ms per-evict
context copy stall       -> 3.1 ms spikes correlated with evict
fallback path hit rate   -> 18% of long-seq requests
```

jia: looks like two things colliding: (1) workspace fragmentation on L4 causes the optimized packed kernel to be unavailable at eviction time, and (2) our seqlen heuristic currently flips kernels at 768. once eviction reduces available workspace the selector downgrades.

ramon: +1. Also the batching heuristic coalesces small clients into a batch that trips a different path. On L4 the memory layout for the small-batch kernel is fragile when combined with KV eviction. Might be worth separating the hot-path for `evict==true` so we avoid kernel switching mid-request.

kevin: proposal: add an "evict-aware" preset for low-memory accelerators that (a) raises the seqlen autopick threshold from 768 -> 900, (b) prefers the packed kernel for small batches (`prefer_packed=true`), and (c) extend KV hot-cache lifetime by +50ms. quick config diff: 
```
# preset: l4-evict-aware
seqlen_autopick_threshold: 900
prefer_packed_kernel: true
kv_hot_lifetime_ms: 250 -> 300
batch_timeout_ms: 2 -> 4
```

marta: ran a quick A/B with that preset on the same workload, preliminary numbers show tail went down to ~6% bump instead of 18%, median unchanged. I'll push a full sweep overnight. :thumbsup:

jia: can we also add a lightweight probe in the selector: check `available_workspace` after eviction and prefer the small-kernel only if available_workspace > 1.1x model_workspace. That avoids flip-flopping.

kevin: +1. Also add telemetry tags: `kernel_autopick_reason`, `evict_flag`, `workspace_bytes` so we can filter traces easily.

marta: creating draft PR with the l4-evict-aware preset + selector probe. link: https://redwood.internal/changes/evict-preset-1968 (runs queued).

deploy-bot: perf-run queued: run_id=pr-1968-sweep, cluster=l4-pool-3, ETA ~7h.

ramon: nice. if overnight sweep looks good we should add the preset behind a rollout flag and enable for the L4 pool only. also schedule a small regression test for A100/H100 to confirm no perf regressions there.

marta: noted. action items: (1) finish PR + tests (marta), (2) telemetry keys (kevin), (3) sweep results + canary rollout (ramon). I'll post results tomorrow AM. :eyes:
